status.closedToday: Closed for the rest of today

saved.title: Saved places
saved.noFavourites: Save places you go to often from their details page, or tap Add.
saved.onThisPhone: Saved places stay on this phone. Sign in to keep them if you change phones.
saved.chooseOnMapNote: For a house or a spot that isn't listed

report.title: Report
report.atMapCentre: At the centre of the map
report.descriptionPlaceholder: Add a short note when you're parked

report.thanks: Thanks for the report. Other drivers can see it now.

errors.noLocation: We don't know where you are yet. Move the map to the spot and try again.
errors.tooMany: You've sent a lot of reports. Try again in a little while.
errors.outsideBrunei: Reports can only be made in Brunei.

reportDetail.youSaidStillThere: You said it's still there. Thank you.
reportDetail.youSaidGone: You said it's gone. Thank you.
reportDetail.yours: This is your report. Other drivers confirm it.
reportDetail.gone: This report has ended or been cleared.
reportDetail.clearedThanks: Thanks. Drivers agree it's gone, so it's off the map.

why.report: Reports need an account so we can stop spam and thank the drivers who help. Everything else works without one.
why.profile: An account lets you post and confirm reports. Everything else works without one.

signIn.codeNote: We send a 6-digit code. No password to remember.
signIn.devCode: Development build: email isn't set up yet, so your code is {{code}}
signIn.resendIn: Send a new code in {{seconds}} s
signIn.nicknameWhy: Other drivers see this on your reports, never your email.
signIn.privacy: By continuing you agree to the Privacy policy. We never post anything for you.

errors.invalid_code: That code is wrong or has expired. Ask for a new one.
errors.too_many_requests: Please wait a little before asking for another code.
errors.nickname_taken: That nickname is taken. Try another.
errors.account_unavailable: This account can't sign in. Contact us if you think that's a mistake.
errors.generic: Something's not right. Check what you entered and try again.

profile.signedOutBody: Sign in to post and confirm reports. Search, the map and saved places work without an account.
profile.needsNicknameBody: Pick a nickname to start reporting.
profile.comingSoon: Points, badges, your reports and settings are coming soon.
